title: Atlassian - User searches failing
text:
Service: Atlassian
Incident: User searches failing
Status: resolved
Impact: none
Started: 2024-02-07T16:40:28.378Z
Resolved: 2024-02-07T17:44:38.545Z
Updates:
- 2024-02-07T17:44:38.545Z: resolved - Between 15:40 UTC to 15:57 UTC customers experienced intermittent failures when searching for users in Atlassian cloud services: Confluence, Jira Work Management, Jira Service Management, Jira Software, Atlassian Bitbucket, Jira Product Discovery, and Compass. The issue has been resolved and the service is operating normally.
- 2024-02-07T17:05:21.068Z: monitoring - We have mitigated the problem. We are now monitoring closely.
- 2024-02-07T16:40:28.540Z: investigating - We are investigating an issue with our user search service that is impacting Atlassian cloud service: Confluence, Jira Work Management, Jira Service Management, Jira Software, Atlassian Bitbucket, Jira Product Discovery, and Compass. We will provide more details within the next hour.

We have mitigated the problem. We are now monitoring closely.
